entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Shri R.P. Mishra - Advocate for the appellants.
Shri Irfan Khan - Advocate for the respondent No.2.

This case was heard and reserved for orders on 11.03.2025.
2.
It seen that that no one appeared on behalf of respondent No.1., although service of notice has been received as per office note dated 30.03.2024.
Also neither any one appeared on behalf of the respondent No.3 i.e. National Insurance Company, although Vakalatnama is already filed nor this court proceeded expert against them.

3. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by appellants against the impugned award dated 24.12.2019 passed by the MACT, District - Betul in claim case No.187/17 (Tulsa Gupta and other vs. Sunu Raghuwansi and others) whereby learned Tribunal for the death of Balkrishna Gupta, in motor accident dated 23.06.2017 has awarded the compensation of Rs.46,20,336/- and held that liability is on non- applicants No.1 and 2 i.e. Driver and owner of the vehicle, but this appeal has been filed challenging the finding of the tribunal to the effect that liability on respondent Nos.1 and 2 jointly and severely is wrong and amount cannot be recovered from owner and driver as they are very poor, therefore, liability should be shifted on the Insurance Company and thereafter the Insurance 2 MA-2800-2020 Company may recover it from respondents Nos.1 and 2.

entities.text: Tulsa Gupta and other vs. Sunu Raghuwansi and others

sentences.text: Therefore, hearing of respondent No.3- Insurance Company is essential but no one appeared on behalf of the Insurance Company on 11.03.2025 when the case was finally heard.
4. Therefore, in this appeal for enhancement of compensation and pay and recover order against the Insurance Company, it is necessary to hear the Insurance Company.
Although Vakalatnama of Shri S. Dubey is filed but he did not appear on 11.03.2025 and neither his presence nor his absence is marked.
